list: The official 55 trophies, as published on PSN and listed by Exophase & PSNProfiles, 18 Nov 2026

meta.missable: Potentially 1 — Positive Mental Attitude (the Chapter 1 balcony meditation; still unconfirmed whether it counts)
meta.cheats: Cheats disable trophies and saving (PowerPyx, via GTABase/TechWiser)
meta.honestyNote: Trophy names, descriptions and grades are the official PSN list, shown as published. Methods follow PowerPyx's guide as reported on 18–19 Nov 2026, rewritten here in this guide's own words. Two trophies (Bad Luck, I Guess and Ten Pin) had no confirmed method on that date and are marked unconfirmed instead of guessed at.

roadmap.title: Play the story — and catch the one missable meditation
roadmap.text: Work through the five chapters, taking optional missions when they appear. While you play, scan vehicles with the WAiNK app and study animals through binoculars — the post-story 100% checklist already counts story progress. Save manually at the start and end of each chapter (15 slots); there is no mission replay and no New Game+. One thing cannot wait: in Chapter 1, after Down to Earth, find Lucia in the kitchen in the morning, follow her onto the balcony and pick Accept — that meditation may be needed for Positive Mental Attitude and it vanishes after Chapter 1. Everything else can be done in free-roam.

roadmap.title: The 100% checklist and 70 of 80 challenges
roadmap.text: Once the credits roll, the 100% checklist opens at Progress > Stats > 100% Completion. It is forgiving — PowerPyx puts it near 60% of everything the game offers: scan any 200 of 277 base vehicles, study any 100 of 255 animals, finish any 100 optional missions and any 70 of 80 challenges. Only robberies, underwater discoveries, shooting ranges, drone races and Bret's quests need full completion. Most of the grind trophies pop here.

roadmap.title: Strangers & Freaks and misc cleanup
roadmap.text: Finish the 8 stranger strands that count (Kirk, Kyle, Yago and Pilot Pete), the five side-character finales, and whatever misc trophies are left — the cryptic ones, the money ones and the stunt ones. Then the platinum pops.

trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: The platinum pops by itself once the other 54 are earned — there is nothing extra to do. Work through the three roadmap stages (story, 100% checklist, cleanup) and PowerPyx's estimate for the full run is around 200 hours.
steps: Finish the 5-chapter story
Work the 100% checklist after the credits
Clean up Strangers & Freaks and the misc trophies

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide: The toughest trophy in the set, and usually the last one most players earn. Once the story ends, the 100% checklist appears under Progress > Stats > 100% Completion — and it is lenient: PowerPyx reckons it covers about 60% of what the game offers. You need any 200 of 277 base vehicles scanned, any 100 of 255 animals studied, any 100 optional missions, and any 70 of 80 challenges. Only robberies, underwater finds, shooting ranges, drone races and Bret's quests need completing in full. Progress made during the story already counts, and nothing on the checklist can be missed.

Scan 200 vehicles and study 100 animals as you play
Complete any 100 optional missions

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: With your partner, rob 3 shops back-to-back while keeping your wanted level the whole time — stay in the flashing red/blue wanted state, not the solid red heat state. Bring an armored vest, sticky bombs and healing (Zombix/Adrenaline). The three jewelry stores in north Vice City work well (after Chapter 3's Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs); loot a couple of items in each, crack the back-room safe with sticky bombs, and keep going to a 4th shop if it does not pop — the unlock is delayed about 30 seconds after leaving the third shop.

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Down 5 enemies in a single Combat Focus (L3+R3 while aiming — it slows time and highlights weak spots). Buff your focus first: eat and drink, wash up at home, and use Adrenaline to stretch the slow-mo. Line the shot up at a Gang Operation with an assault rifle like the Duke 556, and wear body armor so you can step out of cover. It does not trigger on soldiers, police or civilians. Focus has 4 levels — shooting ranges, golf, pool, fishing and headshots all raise it, so this often pops naturally late in the run.
steps: Raise Focus to level 3–4 (ranges, golf, pool, fishing)
Buff up: food, Adrenaline, body armor
At a Gang Operation, trigger Combat Focus and drop 5 enemies in one go

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.guide: Rob any 5 bank vaults and escape. First finish the Chapter 4 optional mission That's Where The Money Is… — it teaches the routine: tail a security van to a bank, slip in while the vault is open, and bring your partner to carry a second bag. After that, pay Yasmani $10,000 for van tips (do his two Payday Loans jobs first). There are 8 large bank jobs and the 100% checklist needs all of them, so this pops on the way. Each vault pays up to $205,000 — and every robbery spikes you to 4 stars, so escape on a fast bike and swap cars to shake the heat.
steps: Finish That's Where The Money Is… in Chapter 4
Buy Yasmani's security-van tips ($10,000)

trophies.guide: At Kingpin Bowling in Port Gellhorn (a gang operation), steal all three key valuables: the luxury watch in the south-east office, the unique shotgun 'Gutterball Moreland 850' on the north-east table, and the safe in the north-east hallway (sticky bombs open it). It unlocks during the Chapter 2 optional mission Hit Kingpin Bowling. The trophy pops after you escape the police — and if you miss an item, the robbery icon respawns later, so it is not missable.
steps: Start Hit Kingpin Bowling (Chapter 2 optional mission)
Take the watch, the Gutterball shotgun and the safe
Escape the police

trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.guide: Reach maximum strength with both Jason and Lucia at the same time. Check strength under Touchpad > Jason & Lucia. Work out together — call your partner and train at a fitness club (filter the map by Activities) so both progress at once; there is also a home gym after the story. You can only switch characters after Chapter 2's Coffee Break.
steps: After Chapter 2's Coffee Break, call your partner
Train together at fitness clubs
Reach max strength with both characters at once

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.guide: Make 500 choices that move your criminal profile. Turn on profile notifications (Settings > UI > HUD Notifications > Criminal Profile = On) and watch for the demon-face icon. Profiles run Professional (stealthy, clean escapes) through Hardened, Violent and Psycho — and Irredeemable is permanent, so do not go overboard. It accrues passively through robberies and fights; if it is the last one left, farming it is as blunt as running over civilians and cops.
steps: Turn on Criminal Profile notifications in Settings > UI
Play normally — robberies and fights count
Check the count by opening this trophy in the list

trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.guide: A UFO easter egg. After 2 AM, alone, drive the road north-west of the Starlet Motel in Kelly County. Sometimes a blinking car is parked at the roadside — if it is not there, drive away and come back. Follow the path into the woods from the car and you will see the UFO (bright blue light in the sky). Walk up to it: it drops an abducted woman. Talk to her, offer to help, then go back to her car at the roadside.
steps: After 2 AM, alone, drive the road north-west of Starlet Motel (Kelly County)
Find the blinking car at the roadside
Follow the path into the woods, approach the UFO, help the woman, return to her car

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Launder $250,000 of marked bills through your contacts. First finish the Chapter 3 mission Credit Check (Meet Raul's Crew) to unlock the Dye Pack Jammer, then rob banks and Payday Loans and carry the marked bills to a fence — Yasmani in Vice City pays the most. The total is cumulative across robberies, and bank vaults pay up to $205,000 each, so it comes naturally with the robbery trophies.
steps: Finish Credit Check in Chapter 3 to unlock the Dye Pack Jammer
Rob banks and Payday Loans
Deliver $250,000 of marked bills to a fence (Yasmani pays most)

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles in the Scooter Bros app. The app arrives after the Chapter 2 mission Moses (Take a Vehicle to Moses). You need garage space first — each garage adds parking spots — so buy garages (see Little Boxes), then drive stolen cars to Moses in Port Gellhorn and choose Respray, then Register. At first he only takes cars without trackers; from Chapter 3 you can also register standard-tracker cars at any Pay 'n' Spray. Registration costs money, so use cheap cars and bikes.
steps: Finish the Moses mission in Chapter 2
Buy garages for parking space
Drive stolen cars to Moses in Port Gellhorn — Respray, then Register (10 total)
